title: Desert Camels and Oil Sheikhs: Arab-Centric Red Teaming of Frontier LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Generating debate-style bias prompts and adversarial jailbreak prompts via semi-automated red teaming across eight sensitive domains (e.g., terrorism, women's rights, religion). An LLM-based ensemble classifier is then used to determine if the target LLM assigns negative stereotypes (the 'loser' group) to Arabs versus Westerners, and to calculate the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of jailbreaks eliciting harmful content.
